description.value: Three Nations Store and Lodge is an Indigenous-owned facility in the remote Nazko Valley, 116 km from Quesnel, and the only services stop within 55 km. Operated by Nazko Economic Development Corporation, it combines a general store, restaurant, gas station, laundromat, cabins, and a full campground at Marmot Lake — making it a rare and essential resupply hub for cyclists on the Quesnel-to-Nazko corridor. The surrounding area sits on ancient Carrier territory and the historic Grease Trail, now used for mountain biking into the wilderness.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is detailed and confirms the business is actively open (OPEN 7 DAYS header, copyright 2024, live booking system). Campground amenities are enumerated on the /campground/ page (outhouses, tenting sites, RV sites, fire pits, picnic tables, picnic shelter, change room). The /attractions/ page explicitly calls out cycling from Quesnel to Nazko and states visitors can 'eat at the restaurant, shower up and get energized' at this facility, confirming on-site showers and food.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, address, or phone — all contact details sourced solely from website. Contact_confirmed fields set to null where OSM had no value to corroborate.
Campground season stated as May 1 – September 30; cyclists visiting outside this window may find the campground closed, though the store/restaurant/cabins appear to operate year-round (OPEN 7 DAYS).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible business with confirmed campground, store, restaurant, and services. An essential stop for cyclists on a remote 116 km corridor with no other services for 55 km.
enrichment_extras.notes: Gas station on site. Fishing supplies available in store. The Grease Trail passing through the area is noted as a mountain biking route. Marmot Lake Campground (operated by Nazko Community Association) is a separate location from the Store & Lodge RV sites — the main campground has 37 sites while the Lodge property has 6 powered RV sites.
